title: Investigational New Drug Application (IND)
provenance: Official FDA secured PDF provided by the product owner (upload). Canonical source: fda.gov forms catalog.
note: Official FDA blank form, dynamic Adobe LiveCycle XFA. Its AcroForm layer is empty, which was long read as 'no fillable fields' — the fields are in the XFA packets and they are real (283 declared, 246 fillable). It is filled through the XFA datasets packet via a PDF incremental update, so every original byte is preserved and Acrobat renders the genuine FDA form. The canonical->SOM-path map is code-reviewed in server/services/ind-forms/official-field-maps.ts (OFFICIAL_XFA_FIELD_MAPS) rather than carried in this manifest's fieldMap, and every path in it is re-verified against this template's own datasets skeleton at fill time. assetTrusted/reviewedBy are left for a named reviewer; they gate the AcroForm fieldMap contract, which does not apply to this form.
xfaFieldCountsMeasuredOn: vendored asset, listXfaFields() over the XFA template + datasets packets
